metadata.chapterTitleEnglish: Fatal signs in shadows, complexion, and luster
metadata.publisher: Charak Samhita Research, Training and Skill Development Centre

introduction: If there is any distortion in the image of the examiner reflected as a shadow in the pupil of the patient, should be considered as a sign of imminent death of the patient. Nimittanurupa vikriti (image pertaining to death) will serve as a yard stick to measure the span of life. The chapter deals with clinical observations of changes in skin complexion, pupillary reactions and their relevant prognosis. The Sanskrit word "panna" means destruction or deterioration. Hence the chapter deals with the deterioration of complexion due to various disease pathologies leading to bad prognosis and death.
